name: Vastus lateralis multiscale anatomy pilot

muscle.registration: Source coordinates retained, translated to local center; no donor microstructure registration

fascicle.registration: Representative cropped segment; no measured placement inside the source muscle

sarcomere.registration: Representative cropped filament lattice, selected dimensions; no donor registration or resolved atomic structures
sarcomere.motion: Symmetric Z-disc and attached thin-filament translation; thick filaments and M line stay fixed. No calcium, ATP, force, titin or cross-bridge state.

fiber.registration: Representative partial myofiber; dimensions are illustrative choices, not donor measurements

visualBrief: Anatomical 3D teaching specimen: realistic bundled longitudinal tissue, selectively opened connective sheaths, clearly visible cut faces, peripheral nuclei, packed striated myofibrils and adjacent capillaries. Restrained warm tissue colors on a dark neutral field. Stable, inspectable semantic structures.
negativeBrief: No cartoon human silhouette, invented clinical tissue measurements, anatomy-as-connectivity claim, decorative blood flow claimed as solved transport, opaque shells concealing every interior, float-scale loss, or paid provider assets.

licenses.generatedGeometryAndTextures: MIT, project original; informed by anatomy references, no copied figure images

references.use: Sliding filament organization: Z discs approach, A band remains fixed, I band and H zone narrow. Chosen lengths, cropped lattice and sparse heads are representative, not measured. Accessed 2026-09-17.
Fascicle/fiber/myofibril hierarchy, connective tissue layers and peripheral nuclei; qualitative guidance. Dimensions chosen for the prototype are disclosed separately.

validationClaimsExcluded: Complete P2 including brain region package

topology.note: Generated meshes must be closed 2-manifolds except named inspection windows. BodyParts3D source surfaces keep their original, non-watertight topology and are never repaired in place.
knownUnresolved: Crossing Z-disc links and M-line links entering their lattice node spheres interpenetrate as separate closed components; no boolean union or intersection test is applied. Coincident duplicate faces are rejected by the GLB byte check.

muscleContext.method: Blender Decimate (collapse) of each source surface
muscleContext.claim: Display-only derivative; source bytes and topology remain in the detail representation.

derivatives.note: Closed collision/simulation derivatives, kept separate from display meshes and never loaded as anatomy.

muscleSimulationDomain.method: Voxel remesh of each source surface
muscleSimulationDomain.claim: Watertight derivative for volume/collision experiments; not the source surface and not donor-validated.

collision.claim: Coarse collision proxies; not a validated mechanical domain.
